The removal of the old linked list management code and the introduction of the `list_head` mechanism allows for more efficient processing of pending buffers during each TX NAPI cycle, ensuring that buffers are completed even in low-traffic scenarios. This change addresses the issue of potentially blocking applications from sending further traffic due to unprocessed TX completions.
